svg.title: Skill Journey Section Architecture Plan
svg.desc: A planning diagram showing the proposed layout and components for the interactive skill/education journey section

g.text: GSTR Recon tool, Portfolio, CA Finals
SphereGeometry + OrbitControls for the rotating globe
